remarks: New Construction, just started this Farmhouse/Colonial with 4800 square feet. This Open Floor plan offer a two-story entry Foyer with a formal Dining Room and Living Room on either side. A modern open Kitchen with center island and informal dining area that flows into the Family Room with gas fireplace. Upstairs, the Primary Bedroom suite is generous, complete with a luxurious Closet space and an elegant Bath. Three additional Bedrooms two full Baths and a convenient second floor Laundry Room. extra space available on the third floor and walk-out basement, all this on 2 acres convenient location close to Town center and Train.
